text:
maria: quick heads-up — saw ~18% drop in prefix cache hit-rate for model=gptj-6b on /summarize in us-west since last deploy. dashboard: https://rdw.infra/dashboards/abc123 :eyes:
raj: timeline? was there a deploy around then?
deploy-bot: deploy completed by alyssa at 2024-08-01T03:45Z — canary -> prod, change: kernel selection tweak (matmul microkernel update)
ben: I pulled the panel, confirmed hit-rate (7d->1d) went 72% -> 59%. token-saved/route dropped proportionally.
ben: sample query:
```
SELECT route, model, sum(tokens_saved) as saved, avg(hit_rate) as hit
FROM cache_metrics
WHERE region='us-west' AND route='/summarize' AND model='gptj-6b'
GROUP BY route, model
```
raj: hmm, did kernel change affect key normalization or KV indexing? unlikely but possible. any keying change in runtime config?
alyssa: no keying change in config, we changed kernel selection threshold (sequence length cutoff) and default batching heuristic for small requests.
maria: sending sampled request ids to ben — maybe small prompt prefix shapes now miss prefetch keys.
ben: checked example requests — many have extra trailing whitespace + punctuation. hit key uses trimmed prompt, but our normalizer had a regression when kernel path toggled; logging shows fallback to legacy normalizer for ~30% of requests.
observability-bot: alert created: cache-hit-drop-us-west-summarize @eng-runtime (threshold 12% drop over 1h)
raj: action: (1) add temporary fallback to previous kernel selection for /summarize canary traffic (alyssa) (2) run backfill re-normalizer on sampled requests to recompute keys (ben) (3) tighten dashboard to show per-customer delta so SRE can scope (maria)
alyssa: on it — rolling canary revert for route /summarize for 10% traffic now. will monitor.
maria: thanks — if hit-rate doesn't recover in 20m we escalate to infra-sre and roll full revert.
ben: I'll reprocess sample and post token-saved projection in channel.
raj: also add a mini test to CI to catch normalizer fallback when kernel path changes.
maria: noted. ty all :thumbsup:
